newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Brent firmer, led by oil product futures.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Brent firmer, led by oil product futures.

text.p: SIMEX Brent crude was firmer on Friday, supported by stronger oil product prices and technical buying, brokers said.

They said gas oil opened firmer on Friday in London, adding to gains in recent sessions. London dealers said they expected the front month November contract to be squeezed into its November 12 expiry.
On SIMEX, December Brent was last traded at $22.40 per barrel, up 19 cents compared with London dealings on Thursday when the contract rose six cents to $22.21.

Brokers said December had failed to break below a range of $22.15 to $22.11, prompting a test of higher numbers. In addition, front-month Brent was continuing to outperform NYMEX with the arbitrage below 60 cents.
NYMEX December crude, which rose five cents in New York to $22.74, was last traded on the after-hours ACCESS system at $22.86 per barrel.
Products were also firmer, with December heating oil up 0.26 cent at 67.15 cents per gallon and December gasoline up 0.15 at 63.95 compared with the New York closes on Thursday.
